note: Rustic campground of Yankee Springs Recreation Area (Michigan DNR) beside Deep Lake, near the mountain-bike trailhead parking lot and the Deep Lake Boating Access Site; fishing pier on Deep Lake. Alcohol is prohibited in the campground at all times. The equestrian campground is a separate campground. Reportedly closed for the 2024 season but operating again by 2025. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + park map + MiDNRReservations: electric 0 (confirmed), 78 sites (confirmed) to 40 ft (new), vault toilets + hand-pump water (confirmed); fees $20 (confirmed, 2026 and 2027); reservable (confirmed) with reservation season Apr 1 - Nov 29 (now manual).
